en.badr-shahin: My father (r) said that Sa’d bin Abdullah narrated to him… that Mansour as-Sayqal said:

I was with Abu Abdullah (a) in his pavilion in Mina (during the season of the hajj) when he looked at people and said: They eat, dress, and marry illegally. But you eat, dress, and marry legally. By Allah, it is only you whose hajj is valid and whose deeds are accepted.
